DEA_G1.prompt: What'll it be, son? We take dust.

options.say: Everybody knows the Deacon, son. Small camp.
options.repeat: You'd remember me, son. I'm very memorable.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Well, I hope you find him. Lovely man.

options.repeat: Keep looking, son. He's closer than you'd think.

options.text: Why do they call you the Deacon?
options.say: My mother did. I've kept it. A man should keep something.
options.repeat: Mother's choice. I've never once changed it.

options.say: Gold on the plank, son. House rules. I wrote them.
options.repeat: Dust first. The plank's very particular.

options.say: Shaved it, son. For the heat. And a man starting over likes to see his own face.
options.repeat: It's coming back thicker. They do.

options.text: I am going to leave now, in a dignified manner.

VES_G1.exceptionReason: Doc 109: the opening, doc 03's Duel One opening, was said at THE FIND; TALK TO after it opens the list.

options.text: You sold me a worthless claim.
options.say: I sold you a claim. Worth is your department. Mine's volume.

options.text: I want my four dollars back.
options.say: They're working, son. Money works out here.

options.text: Teach me to lie like that.
options.say: Gold on the plank first, son. Then we can talk about paper.
options.repeat: Plank first. I don't make the rules. Well. I did, but I keep them.

options.text: Teach me to lie like that.
options.say: Can't teach it. Can demonstrate it.
I answer for it constantly. Nobody accepts the answer.

repeats.say: Still answering, son. I've got the answer down very nice by now.

options.text: I need you to sign an affidavit.
options.say: Gold on the plank first, son. Then we can talk about paper.
options.repeat: Plank first. I don't make the rules. Well. I did, but I keep them.

options.text: I need you to sign an affidavit.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Sign a paper saying I sold you mud under false pretenses? Son, that's a confession with a stamp on it.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Tell you what. We'll settle it the local way.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: He points down the bank, at the bar.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: The local way's out on the bar, son. Bring your boots.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Not here, son. Beat me on that bar and you'd have nothing. That bar can't witness a signature.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Beat me in the Nugget's back room, with judges and a pencil, and I'll sign whatever you like.

exchange.speaker: gulch_deacon
exchange.line: Losing a man in front of strangers is business. Beating him in front of his own town is art. I'll take the coach.

options.text: Thank you. This has been clarifying.
